facts.fact: The preface of Cameroon's national statistics development strategy 2021-2030 states that Law No. 2020/010 of 20 July 2020 governing statistical activity formally establishes the national statistical information system (Articles 20 to 22) and places the strategy at the centre of statistical activity (Article 3).
